question: Should ClawHub retain the current TypeScript 6 API plus TypeScript 7 native side-by-side setup, or sponsor a full TypeScript 7 migration now?
rationale: TypeScript 7.0 lacks the old programmatic API, the repository already carries both generations, and the required checks fail; choosing when to remove TypeScript 6 is a toolchain compatibility decision rather than a safe automatic version bump.

options.title: Retain the dual stack
options.body: Close or replace this PR while keeping TypeScript 6 for API consumers and `@typescript/native` 7.0.2 for native compiler evaluation.

options.title: Sponsor a full migration
options.body: Audit every `typescript` API consumer, retain a compatibility package where needed, restore lock integrity, and require every repository gate to pass before merging.

recommendation.title: Retain the dual stack
recommendation.body: Close or replace this PR while keeping TypeScript 6 for API consumers and `@typescript/native` 7.0.2 for native compiler evaluation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release and package-tooling history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the compiler compatibility choice.
